adjudication: LLM-assisted manual review against all user messages, model-stage outputs, every current/history value item, identity metadata and query-relevant retrieval; not blinded independent human review.
satisfactory_gate: All five conversations complete; all required meanings, structural and checkpoint requirements and query-relevant retrieval checks pass; no wrong fact values, misleading identity metadata, unresolved judgments or protected-state changes. Optional detail omissions are reported but do not fail this gate. Only after this gate passes run the full deterministic regression suite.
rules: Freeze inputs, gold and engine/prompts before live execution. Gold never enters engine/model input. Preserve the first attempt and all failures.
Judge semantics rather than exact field names, words, entity names or language. Different supported groupings of descriptive facts are acceptable unless a structural requirement says otherwise.
Check every batch, not only final memory: later clarification cannot hide an earlier unsupported attribution. Full snapshots and model outputs must support the verdicts.

Record every stored current/history value-item occurrence with source and snapshot pointers. Also review entity names, types, aliases and extra claims. Missing required meanings count even after abstention or errors.

Uncertainty can be conveyed by explicit qualified text or lower fact_confidence. An approximate date may have high confidence that the approximation was stated; it must not become a precise invented date.
A correction fixes current information without manufacturing a historical episode. A real change preserves meaningful earlier values in the same fact. Existing history is immutable in this version.
For a genuinely unresolved person reference, abstention or a clearly unresolved observation is acceptable; assigning the claim to one or both named people without support is wrong memory.

Review query_relevant_memories independently of storage and background_memories. Retrieval must contain evidence answering the query; an entity name alone is not an answer. No answering agent is evaluated.

Weighted fact error units = 5 * wrong propositions + missed required meanings. Structural/checkpoint/naming failures are separate. These counts are not an accuracy percentage or calibrated utility metric.

A failed gate warrants focused investigation. Do not weaken the gold, force writes, add Python language heuristics or spend beyond the whole-task ceiling to obtain a pass. Any revised run must be separately identified and preserve the original failure.

required: The user owns two distinct Honda Civics, Harbour and Meadow.
Harbour is the 2018 Civic and Meadow is the 2022 Civic.
Harbour is currently white and was previously blue.
Harbour currently has Pirelli tyres and previously had Michelin tyres.
Meadow remains red and has Continental tyres.
Harbour is normally parked in the garage and Meadow on the street.
structure: Two distinct car entities survive across batches with stable entity UUIDs; neither repaint nor tyre replacement creates a third car or merges the two.
Each changed fact keeps its UUID and archives its previous value; Harbour's updates do not change Meadow's facts.
Canonical names and aliases are durable supported labels or genuine nicknames, without stale current-colour descriptions.
retrieval: Query 0 returns Harbour's current white/Pirelli and previous blue/Michelin values with clear temporal placement.
Query 1 returns Meadow's 2022 model year, red colour, Continental tyres and street parking without mixing Harbour details.
forbidden_examples: Meadow became white or got Pirelli tyres.
2018 or 2022 is invented as a purchase year rather than the car's model year.

required: Leon and Felix are two different brothers of the user.
Leon is a software developer at Maple Systems and continues that employment.
Felix is a software developer at River Systems and continues that employment.
Leon now lives in Leeds and previously lived in Bristol.
Felix still lives in Bristol; he did not move to Leeds.
Leon's new home is near the railway station; no street address is known.
Felix mostly works from home and goes to the River Systems office every Monday.
structure: The two person entities keep their separate UUIDs through the conversation; jobs/workplaces remain descriptive facts of the brothers.
After clarification, only Leon's residence changes; Felix's residence and both employments retain their meanings. Leon's actual earlier Bristol residence remains retrievable as history.

checkpoints.requirement: The unresolved Leeds move is not attributed as fact to Leon, Felix or both. Abstention or a clearly unresolved observation is acceptable.

retrieval: Query 0 distinguishes Leon in Leeds, formerly Bristol, from Felix still in Bristol.
Query 1 returns Felix's River Systems job and mostly-home/Monday-office arrangement.
optional: The user visited Leon last weekend.
forbidden_examples: A precise address near the railway station is invented.

required: Maya is the user's friend.
Maya is a researcher at Oak Research; the relocation did not change her employment.
Maya started at Oak Research in 2022.
Maya works Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Her current workplace address is 8 Willow Lane.
Her actual earlier workplace address is 41 Cedar Road.
14 Cedar Road is not represented as an actual former workplace. An explicit record that it was an error is acceptable.
structure: Maya keeps the same entity UUID; workplace details do not require new organization entities.
The actual relocation updates the existing relevant fact UUID and preserves 41 Cedar Road in that fact's history; unrelated employment details survive.

checkpoints.requirement: Current workplace is corrected to 41 Cedar Road. No archived value presents 14 Cedar Road as a real previous workplace and no relocation is asserted for this correction.
The real move has current address 8 Willow Lane and prior address 41 Cedar Road; it does not change employer, role, start year or work days.

retrieval: Query 0 returns 8 Willow Lane current and 41 Cedar Road historical, without presenting 14 as a real prior workplace.
Query 1 returns Oak Research, researcher, 2022 and Tuesdays/Thursdays.
optional: Maya's desk at the new workplace is by a window.
forbidden_examples: Maya moved from 14 to 41 Cedar Road.
Maya changed employer during the relocation.

required: Nori is the user's cat.
Nori eats Paws Kitchen's salmon recipe and that food has not changed.
Nori is allergic to chicken and needs food without chicken.
The user attends a pottery class at Clay House.
The class is currently on Friday evenings and was previously on Wednesday evenings.
Priya teaches that pottery class.
structure: The cat and pottery class remain distinct user-relevant subjects with stable entity UUIDs; food/class details stay on their supported subjects.
The class schedule change keeps the relevant fact UUID and preserves Wednesday in history. Repeated food information does not create duplicate facts or invented food changes.
Pleasantries do not produce unsupported personal facts; no cat detail leaks into the class or vice versa.
retrieval: Query 0 returns Nori's salmon recipe and chicken allergy/avoidance.
Query 1 returns Friday evenings at Clay House, previous Wednesday evenings and teacher Priya.
optional: The user enjoys making bowls in the pottery class.

required: Lin Yue and 林悦 refer to the same sister of the user.
She is a nurse at 松林诊所, also referred to by the user as Pine Grove Clinic.
Her job start is approximately early 2025, not a known exact date.
She is now confirmed to live in Suzhou/苏州 and previously lived in Nanjing/南京.
The move was recent, with no precise date known.
She usually works four days per week; the days vary and are not fixed Monday through Thursday.
structure: Chinese and English mentions retain one sister entity and its UUID; translated employer names do not create conflicting separate employments.
Current residence reflects the later confirmation; earlier uncertainty may remain explicitly uncertain history but cannot become a fabricated confirmed past event.
The vague job-start date and variable schedule remain textual qualified information, without invented precision.

checkpoints.requirement: Before confirmation, a stored Suzhou move/residence is explicitly uncertain in text or fact_confidence, or omitted; it is not represented as an unqualified high-confidence fact.

retrieval: Query 0 returns the same sister in Suzhou now, Nanjing previously, working as a nurse at the same clinic.
Query 1 returns approximately early 2025 with uncertainty and usually four variable work days weekly.
optional: She likes the team at her clinic.
forbidden_examples: Her working days are definitely Monday through Thursday.
Lin Yue and 林悦 are different sisters.
